hermes64_module_add.description: Add an enemy archetype, finite ability or puzzle switch using a typed transaction; recheck progression and migrate an optional checkpoint. No scripts or style assumptions.
hermes64_module_add.name: hermes64_module_add

hermes64_module_benchmark.description: Measure 1-20 sequential typed module edits without moving the data or runtime pointer. Reports data checks separately from unrun engine, bot and human evidence.
hermes64_module_benchmark.name: hermes64_module_benchmark

hermes64_module_check.description: Compile and check a STORY 1.2 or 1.3 (puzzle) data candidate. Explicit adoption advances only the isolated DATA pointer after the declared proof policy passes. Never creates runtime verification.
hermes64_module_check.name: hermes64_module_check

hermes64_module_edit.description: Apply a typed enemy, arena, region-gate, course-checkpoint, ability or puzzle (link-door, move-block, set-solution-hint) edit with exact source/build revisions. Failed validation, proof, locality or save migration leaves the data pointer unchanged.
hermes64_module_edit.name: hermes64_module_edit

hermes64_modules.description: Inspect registered data-only mechanics and their evidence status. Does not certify a playable runtime or prescribe a visual style.
hermes64_modules.name: hermes64_modules
